units.source_text: 源氏公子谪居须磨，茹苦含辛的期间，在京都也有不少女人惦念他，为他忧伤悲叹。

en.t: During the time when Prince Genji was living in exile at Suma and enduring bitter hardship, many women in the capital also thought of him and grieved sorrowfully for him.

units.source_text: 其中境况优裕的人，则别无痛苦，专为恋情而愁恨。

en.t: Those among them who lived in comfortable circumstances had no other suffering, and were troubled only by the pain of love.

units.source_text: 例如二条院的紫姬，生活富足，不时可以和旅居的公子互通音问。

en.t: For example, Lady Murasaki at the Nijoin lived in comfort and could from time to time exchange letters with the prince in his distant lodging.

units.source_text: 又可替他置备失官后暂用的无纹服装，按时按节派人送去，聊以慰藉相思之苦。

en.t: She could also prepare plain unpatterned garments for him to use temporarily after losing his office, and send them by messengers at the proper seasons, finding some small comfort for the pain of longing.

units.source_text: 然而还有许多人，外人并不知道她们是公子的情侣，公子离京之时她们也只能像陌路人一般旁观，心中却痛苦不堪。

en.t: Yet there were many others whose relationship with the prince was unknown to outsiders, and when he left the capital they could only watch like strangers, while their hearts were filled with unbearable pain.
